headline: CF Montréal out of the playoff race
detail: A 2–0 home loss to MLS-leading Nashville SC (Surridge 52', Mukhtar) at Stade Saputo officially ends Montréal's playoff hopes. They sit 6-18-7.

headline: Montreal Roses win the Supporters' Shield
detail: Tanya Boychuk's late winner, set up by Marie-Yasmine Alidou, beat Ottawa Rapid 1–0 at Stade Boréale. Montreal finish top of the NSL on 45 points: the club's first trophy.

headline: Forge FC are Canadian Champions
detail: 1–1 at Stade Saputo, then 4–2 on penalties vs CF Montréal. The first CPL club ever to win it, and a 2027 CONCACAF Champions Cup place. TNB partners Tavernier and Bruno are in the squad.

headline: Davies scores vs Arsenal
detail: Alphonso Davies equalised in the 35th minute, set up by Harry Kane, in Bayern's 2–2 Champions League draw. His second UCL goal this season.

headline: Badwal named Best Young Player
detail: Vancouver Whitecaps' Jeevan Badwal picked up the 2026 Canadian Championship's Best Young Player award.

headline: Oluwaseyi scores at Anfield
detail: Tani Oluwaseyi scored, assisted by Nathan Saliba, in Villarreal's 4–3 Champions League loss at Liverpool. Tajon Buchanan also played on his return from injury.

headline: Millar brace vs QPR
detail: Liam Millar scored twice in 71 minutes as Birmingham beat QPR 3–0. Three goals in two games.

headline: Larin off injured vs Bolton
detail: Cyle Larin left Southampton's 0–0 draw with Bolton in the 41st minute with a muscle problem. Return date unknown.

headline: Olguin's first pro goal
detail: TNB partner Lucas Olguin equalised in the 44th minute at Vancouver FC. HFX went on to lose 2–1.

headline: Oluwaseyi scores at Napoli
detail: Off the bench to score in Villarreal's 3–1 Champions League win in Naples.
